name: Burrow Pages
description: Static websites from your GitHub and GitLab repositories, on a subdomain of yours, behind a password. Sign in with a code, pick a repository (the most active first) and Burrow serves its files, private ones included, following every push. Static sites only: no server-side code. Experimental.
author: Alexd Aero

actions.label: Pause every site
actions.confirm: Every site stops answering until you resume it. Nothing is deleted.

settings.label: GitHub app client ID
settings.help: The GitHub OAuth app Burrow Pages signs in with (device flow). Burrow Pages' own is filled in; its client ID is public and there is no secret. Use your own app's ID if you'd rather.
